title: Apple says iOS 27 will support iPhone 11, in contrast with 2019 Android flagships like Pixel 4 and Galaxy S10, which got only three years of platform updates (Aamir Siddiqui/Android Authority)
summary: Aamir Siddiqui / Android Authority: Apple says iOS 27 will support iPhone 11, in contrast with 2019 Android flagships like Pixel 4 and Galaxy S10, which got only three years of platform updates — While older Android flagships were put out to pasture long ago, Apple is bringing iOS 27 to the iPhone 11 from 2019. — • — TL;DR
contentText:
Aamir Siddiqui / Android Authority :

Apple says iOS 27 will support iPhone 11, in contrast with 2019 Android flagships like Pixel 4 and Galaxy S10, which got only three years of platform updates   —  While older Android flagships were put out to pasture long ago, Apple is bringing iOS 27 to the iPhone 11 from 2019.  —  •  —  TL;DR
